title: Man arrested after woman and man die in alleged double fatal stabbing in Sydney
summary: Police called to Quakers Hill on Sunday morning after reports of disturbance Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A man has been arrested after a woman and a man – both aged in their 30s – died in an alleged double fatal stabbing in Sydney. Police said emergency services were called to the home in Quakers Hill just before 5am on Sunday, responding to reports of a disturbance. Continue reading...

title: Winter storm brings heavy snow and ice to busy holiday travel weekend
summary: A powerful winter storm is impacting parts of the U.S. with major snowfall, ice, and below zero wind chills. The conditions are disrupting holiday travel and could last through next week.
